functional_requirements: Provide a rigid 90-degree L-shaped connection between a horizontal mounting surface and a vertical mounting surface.
Inside corner fillet radius 5 mm reduces stress concentration at the reentrant corner.
Base and vertical arm share a common 30 mm width and must be centered on the same Y symmetry plane.
No mounting holes or fastening features are specified; the bracket is a single-piece part.
Suitable for single-piece 3D printing (FDM) with uniform 5 mm plate thickness.
special_features: MUST form the base as 50 mm along X (BASE_LENGTH_X), 30 mm along Y (BASE_WIDTH_Y), and 5 mm thick in Z (BASE_THICKNESS_Z), with its bottom face on Z=0.

MUST form the vertical arm as 5 mm thick in X (VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X), 30 mm wide in Y (VERTICAL_ARM_WIDTH_Y), and 30 mm overall tall in Z (VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z), located at X=0 to X=VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X with its bottom flush with the base bottom at Z=0.
MUST NOT place the vertical arm bottom on top of the base; overall Z MUST equal VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z=30 mm, not BASE_THICKNESS_Z + VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z.
MUST center both base and vertical arm on the plane Y=BASE_WIDTH_Y/2 (SYMMETRY_PLANE_OFFSET_Y=15 mm) so all features are symmetric about that XZ-offset plane.
MUST union the base and vertical arm so the reentrant inside corner is at X=VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X, Z=BASE_THICKNESS_Z (5 mm, 5 mm).

MUST apply a concave fillet of radius INSIDE_FILLET_RADIUS=5 mm along the full Y-width inside corner edge where vertical arm inner face X=VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X meets base top face Z=BASE_THICKNESS_Z; the fillet MUST add material into the reentrant corner, not remove material from outer convex edges.
MUST run the 5 mm inside fillet along the full Y width from Y=0 to Y=BASE_WIDTH_Y; the fillet MUST NOT be partial-edge or variable-radius.
MUST produce a single connected solid and MUST NOT add mounting holes, chamfers, or other unspecified features.
MUST keep final overall extents within X=OVERALL_LENGTH_X=50 mm, Y=OVERALL_WIDTH_Y=30 mm, and Z=OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z=30 mm after filleting.

sketches.notes: Closed 4-vertex quad giving the base plate footprint in world XY under the corner_min convention: X=0..50 (BASE_LENGTH_X), Y=0..30 (BASE_WIDTH_Y). Bottom face sits on Z=0; extruded +Z by BASE_THICKNESS_Z=5.

Closed 4-vertex quad giving the vertical arm footprint: X=0..VERTICAL_ARM_THICKNESS_X(5), Y=0..VERTICAL_ARM_WIDTH_Y(30). Extruded +Z by 30 mm so the arm occupies Z=0..30 (flush with the base bottom at Z=0, NOT stacked on top of the base). The X=0..5 / Z=0..5 portion overlaps the base volume so the union is a real volumetric merge.

Closed 4-vertex quad X=5..10 (= INSIDE_CORNER_X .. INSIDE_CORNER_X+R), Y=0..30, placed on the XY plane offset to Z=BASE_THICKNESS_Z=5 and extruded +Z by 5 mm, giving the 5x5x30 corner block Z=5..10. This block is the raw material that the R=5 trimming cylinder converts into the concave inside fillet.

steps.label: Extrude base plate 50 x 30 x 5 (Z = 0..5)
steps.notes: Bottom face on Z=0, top face at Z=BASE_THICKNESS_Z=5. Overall X = 0..50, Y = 0..30.

steps.label: Extrude vertical arm 5 x 30 x 30 (X = 0..5, Z = 0..30, flush at Z = 0)
steps.notes: Arm occupies X=0..5, Y=0..30, Z=0..30. Bottom is flush with the base bottom at Z=0, so overall height stays VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z=30 (no added base thickness).

steps.label: Union base plate and vertical arm into the L-shaped body
steps.notes: Overlapping volumes (X=0..5, Z=0..5) merge into one connected solid. Resulting reentrant inside corner runs along Y=0..30 at X=INSIDE_CORNER_X=5, Z=INSIDE_CORNER_Z=5.

steps.label: Extrude 5 x 5 x 30 corner block at X = 5..10, Z = 5..10
steps.notes: Additive raw material for the inside fillet: X=5..10, Y=0..30, Z=5..10. Bottom face (Z=5) is coplanar with the base top; inner face (X=5) is coplanar with the arm inner face, so both unions are face-to-face.

steps.label: Union the corner block onto the L-shaped body
steps.notes: Body now contains the full 5x5x30 corner block sitting in the reentrant corner (X=5..10, Z=5..10, Y=0..30).

steps.label: Trim corner block with R = 5 cylinder to create the concave inside fillet
steps.notes: Through-cylinder along Y, block spans Y=0..30 (extend past both ends). Cylinder R=5, axis along Y at X=10, Z=10 is tangent to the arm inner face (X=5) at Z=10 and tangent to the base top face (Z=5) at X=10. Subtracting it removes exactly the quarter-disk from the corner block, leaving a full-width (Y=0..30) constant-radius concave R=5 inside fillet that ADDS material into the reentrant corner. Cylinder lies entirely at X>=5 and Z>=5, so no base or arm material other than the block is removed.

steps.label: Extrude base plate 50 x 30 x 5 (Z = 0..5)
steps.notes: Bottom face on Z=0, top face at Z=BASE_THICKNESS_Z=5. Overall X = 0..50, Y = 0..30.

steps.label: Extrude vertical arm 5 x 30 x 30 (X = 0..5, Z = 0..30, flush at Z = 0)
steps.notes: Arm occupies X=0..5, Y=0..30, Z=0..30. Bottom is flush with the base bottom at Z=0, so overall height stays VERTICAL_ARM_HEIGHT_Z=30 (no added base thickness).

steps.label: Union base plate and vertical arm into the L-shaped body
steps.notes: Overlapping volumes (X=0..5, Z=0..5) merge into one connected solid. Resulting reentrant inside corner runs along Y=0..30 at X=INSIDE_CORNER_X=5, Z=INSIDE_CORNER_Z=5.

steps.label: Union the corner block onto the L-shaped body

steps.label: Trim corner block with R = 5 cylinder to create the concave inside fillet
